content.text: {"abstained":false,"abstention_reason":"","answer":"The Gram Panchayat (GP) plays a central role in MGNREGA registration. It receives applications for registration [E01][E03], verifies household eligibility by confirming the household is a real entity, that applicants are local residents, and that they are adult members [E03]. The GP must complete verification within a fortnight of receiving the application [E03]. Once a household is found eligible, the GP issues a Job Card to the household within a fortnight of the application [E03]. The GP also enters all particulars of eligible households into the MIS (NREGASoft) system [E03].","cited_evidence_ids":["E01","E03"],"claim_to_evidence":[{"claim":"The Gram Panchayat receives applications for registration","evidence_ids":["E01","E03"]},{"claim":"The GP verifies household eligibility including whether the household is a real entity, applicants are local residents, and are adult members","evidence_ids":["E03"]},{"claim":"The GP must complete verification within a fortnight of receiving the application","
